The same annotators as in Section 5.2 perform manual evaluation on four criteria in cross-cultural recipes adaptation, adopted from : Grammar (GRA): The results are grammatically correct and fluent. Consistency (CON): The results include a complete and detailed title, ingredients and steps, facilitating users to cook according to the recipe. Preservation (PRE): The results retain the original ingredients and flavors of the source recipe. Cultural Appropriateness (CUL): The results conform to the dietary habits and recipe writing conventions of the target culture.
guideline: Rate on a 7-point scale for four criteria: Grammar, Consistency, Preservation, and Cultural Appropriateness.

Each dimension is rated on a 7-point scale and a higher score indicates superior performance. We also annotate the 3-scale relevance of recipe retrieval results and computed the Exact match precision at the first position (P@1).
